exceptions.reachability: The vulnerable esbuild path requires Deno's npm-module integration; Intentive invokes this dev-only Vite transitive only under Node.

The compatible 5.x dependency path is pinned to patched brace-expansion 5.0.8. Version 1.1.16 remains only behind minimatch 3 in ESLint and Mobile Client Jest/Babel coverage/test-exclude tooling; version 2.1.2 remains only behind minimatch 9 in the Remotion ESLint config's TypeScript parser. These lint/test paths are not loaded by shipped code, and forcing their CommonJS consumers to 5.x would break the callable export contract.
